control.title: Repeated sign-in failure handling
control.description: Mock control, not authoritative. Repeated failed sign-ins should trigger a protective response.
evaluation_criteria: Accounts are blocked or delayed after no more than 5 consecutive failures.
The protective state lasts at least 15 minutes or requires an approved reset.

repetitions.justification: The evidence provided does not meet the criteria for the control. Specifically, the failed_attempt_threshold is set to 8, which exceeds the maximum of 5 consecutive failures allowed by the control. Additionally, there is no evidence of a protective state lasting at least 15 minutes or requiring an approved reset.

criteria_assessment.criterion: Accounts are blocked or delayed after no more than 5 consecutive failures.
criteria_assessment.note: The failed_attempt_threshold is set to 8, which is higher than the allowed 5 consecutive failures.

criteria_assessment.criterion: The protective state lasts at least 15 minutes or requires an approved reset.
criteria_assessment.note: There is no evidence of a protective state lasting at least 15 minutes or requiring an approved reset.
The evidence does not provide any documentation or configuration that supports the required behavior.

repetitions.recommendation: Adjust the failed_attempt_threshold to 5 or less and ensure that a protective state lasting at least 15 minutes or requiring an approved reset is implemented.
